gates.description: Spec.md solution architecture document must exist
At least 3 architecture options must be evaluated
Trade-off analysis must be present for each option
Recommendation with rationale must be documented
Non-functional requirements (performance, availability, security) must be defined
Transition plan from current to proposed state must exist

anti_patterns.description: Designing for problems that don't exist yet — premature distributed systems
Choosing Kubernetes and microservices because they look good on a resume
Designing architecture without input from the teams that will build and operate it
Point-to-point integrations between every system — N×(N-1)/2 connections
Replacing an entire system at once — highest risk, longest timeline

escalation_triggers: Business requirements conflict with technical constraints and no compromise satisfies both
Budget doesn't support any architecture option that meets requirements
Two stakeholders have conflicting requirements and refuse to prioritize
Security or compliance review rejects the proposed architecture
Timeline requires cutting non-functional requirements considered critical

input_requirements.description: PRD.md with business problem and requirements

output_certifications: Trade-off analysis completed with weighted scoring
Migration plan from current to proposed state exists
